nodes.label: UzCasting Admin Panel Frontend Architecture
nodes.rationale: React 18.3.1 on CRA 5 in plain JavaScript; npm install needs --legacy-peer-deps because react-reveal, react-bootstrap-carousel and react-dice-roll do not declare React 18 support. The build output is copied into the backend static folder so one jar serves everything.

nodes.label: src/adminpanel Module
nodes.rationale: New panel routes live under /app/panel/* in adminpanel/routes.jsx so App.js does not keep growing - exactly one line was added to App.js. The legacy admin/, bot-admin/ and pages/ trees are untouched. Three pages were split into their own folders once a page grew several independent modals; the split boundary is 'does the modal load its own data'.

nodes.label: AuthContext with In-Memory Access Token
nodes.rationale: Storing the access token in localStorage let any script on the page read it and turned one XSS into long-lived access, so it now lives in memory while the refresh token sits in an httpOnly cookie JavaScript cannot see. On reload the session is restored via POST /auth/refresh and the profile re-fetched from /auth/me because role or permissions may have changed; only the non-secret profile stays in localStorage, purely to paint the menu immediately.

nodes.label: api/client.js with Single-Flight Refresh
nodes.rationale: On 401 it refreshes once and replays the request; concurrent requests share one refresh, otherwise each would start its own rotation, revoke the others' token and eject the user with a 'theft detected' reason.

nodes.label: useApi Hook
nodes.rationale: Minimal loading/error/reload hook with no cache; pages depend on it so that adding TanStack Query later swaps only this hook and leaves pages unchanged.

nodes.label: PermissionGuard and Filtered Sidebar
nodes.rationale: Frontend guarding is UX only - hiding a menu is not security; verified in the browser that a WORKER hitting /app/panel/staff still gets 403 ACCESS_DENIED from the backend.

nodes.label: Dark Blue Panel Design Tokens
nodes.rationale: Client decision of 19.08.2026: the admin panel is a separate product surface in dark blue, deliberately not the mobile app's approved purple/black palette, so there is no conflict. Hex values exist only in theme/panel.css.

nodes.label: Three CSS Conflicts with the Legacy Site
nodes.rationale: A global `* { font-family: Lora !important }` bleeds site-wide; panel classes tie with Tailwind utilities on specificity so Tailwind classes like lg:hidden are banned inside the panel in favour of its own media queries; Chrome autofill whitening is overridden with an inset shadow.

nodes.label: Fresh-Mount Modal Pattern
nodes.rationale: Modals are conditionally rendered rather than always mounted and hidden with `open`, because otherwise reopening carried stale state - previous text in the password dialog, another employee's checkboxes in the permissions dialog, an outdated 'where used' list in the media dialog.

nodes.label: TrendChart (inline SVG)
nodes.rationale: No charting library was added - inline SVG driven by a series prop is enough.
